purpose: Broaden real acquired MRI/US anatomy and staged-imaging component research across the existing public surgical cohort; not recorded actions, force validation, clinical utility, or RL trajectories. No assertion that every patient has glioma.

split.algorithm: Preserve ReMIND-001 DEVELOPMENT. For remaining113 source PatientIDs, SHA256 UTF-8(namespace+exact PatientID), sort ascending hex digest then ID; ranks1-79 TRAIN,80-96 SELECT,97-113 MEASUREMENT_EVAL.
split.prior_source_metadata_selection: Earlier001 pilot screened clinical metadata for minimum eligible ID. That metadata exposure is not erased; no new clinical/outcome fields were read to choose this split.

family_policy.all_source_timepoints_modalities_annotat: Inherit one person role; no series-level split
family_policy.other_collections: Identity overlap remains unresolved; source affiliations or differing IDs do not prove independence. Resolve conflicts before cross-source evaluation/admission; retain existing protected roles on proven aliases.
family_policy.pretrained_exposure: Unknown prior model exposure bars independent-transfer claims; it is not a block on separately labeled research TRAIN byte acquisition.
family_policy.ReMIND2Reg: Any ReMIND2Reg derivative proven linked to the same CaseNumber inherits this exact ReMIND patient role. Never count it as a new patient or independent transfer cohort.

acquisition_scope.first_scope: All source-indexed MR and US series for79 TRAIN people, without outcome or quality filtering.
acquisition_scope.segmentation_disposition: Do not merge automatic/manual SEG with acquired MR/US observation counts; source-lineage eligibility and intended-use admission remain separate. This first raw-imaging transport scope excludes SEG.
acquisition_scope.ReMIND001: Already acquired; preserve existing receipts and skip all redownloads
acquisition_scope.exact_source_objects: Pending series-prefix HTTPS listings, exact size/checksum binding before individual payloads
acquisition_scope.size_status: Index estimates reconstructed from rounded series_size_MB; exact bytes require object listings/headers and checksum binding before GET.

diagnosis_eligibility.discrepancy: Publisher broad92 and exact three-label88 differ in definition; retain raw labels and do not relabel remaining cases.
diagnosis_eligibility.glioma_specific_policy_scope: Only63 candidate TRAIN people matching the exact three-label predicate may enter a future separately admitted glioma-specific policy study. Other TRAIN diagnoses may support generic imaging components only; no glioma-policy admission is granted here.
diagnosis_eligibility.preoperative_availability: unknown; diagnosis is cohort eligibility metadata only, excluded from actor/planner/reward inputs.
diagnosis_eligibility.no_QC_based_replacement: Failures retain original assigned role and denominator; SELECT/EVAL never moved into TRAIN.
